notes: Total 60 as listed; the section headers add to 61 (Effects is headed 12 but lists 11 cards). The line 'denotes starting' is the list's key (its marker was lost), not a card.

Starting per the strategy: the objective (which pulls Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber and Secret Plans), with Prepared Defenses getting Imperial Arrest Order, Oppressive Enforcement and Crush The Rebellion; several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.
'Crush The Rebellion (Broken Concentration depending on meta)' is an either/or line, kept as one UNKNOWN row with the posted text (the strategy names Crush as the usual pick).

Posted 'Cloud City Docking Bay' dested the Dark site Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (Platform 327 is a Light site); Lando Calrissian and Lobot are the Dark Cloud City characters; Battle Order, Secret Plans and Oppressive Enforcement are the Effects (2000), not the later Defensive Shields.
The update text says 'Oppressive Enforcement and Grabbers were a must', but no Grabber is in the list; not added. This is version 2.0 of an earlier post ('Evan's Quick Refrigeration Service').
